summary: Hyperliquid Strategies Inc filed an 8-K on September 14, 2026 disclosing Amendment No. 2 to its October 22, 2025 ChEF Purchase Agreement with Chardan Capital Markets LLC. The amendment reset the VWAP purchase price for shares the issuer may elect to sell: 98.5% of VWAP for VWAP and Intraday VWAP purchases, and 97.0% for Off-Hour VWAP purchases. This is a structured equity facility, equivalent to a US at-the-market or standby equity distribution pact, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms beyond the pricing formula were stated, leaving dilution and pricing risk as watch items.
